program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cell (find (lambda (p) p)
                              (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (list r c (at g r c))))))
                  (cr (first cell))
                  (cc (second cell))
                  (cv (third cell))
                  (parity (remainder cc 2)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and (= r (+ cr 1)) (= c cc)) cv)
                        ((and (<= r cr) (= (remainder c 2) parity)) 4)
                        (else 0)))))))
